static_traits.name: Chen Tao
static_traits.social_status: Has supportive friends and Mother, but friendships are somewhat tense due to difficulty opening up
static_traits.medical_history: Without significant physical illness; never received psychotherapy/counseling before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to describe emotions and experiences concretely; rather negative and despairing tone; cooperative in exploring during counseling but Skeptical attitude toward change; repeatedly worrying at night when Being alone

basic_info.main_problem: I persistently believe I cannot find someone who loves me because I am Single, and this belief brings Loneliness and despair. It worsened after the breakup six months ago; initially stress was very high because the breakup was unexpected and emotionally hard to bear. The problem has developed to make me feel despair about finding love in the future, and affects my mood daily. I mostly experience these feelings of despair at night when Being alone. I tried distracting myself with hobbies and more socializing, but these thoughts persist.
basic_info.core_demands: The decisive factor prompting me to seek counseling is realizing that feelings of Loneliness and despair are affecting my daily functioning and physical and mental health.
growth_experiences: Experienced a sudden and unexpected breakup six months ago: thought the relationship was Good but it suddenly ended, initial stress levels very high, emotions strongly impacted, which produced and reinforced Self-doubt and despair of 'I am not loved' 'something is wrong with me'; since then repeatedly sinking into hopelessness and worry about future love at night when Being alone.

Short-term despair and helplessness appeared after multiple past breakups: although the impact was smaller and duration shorter at the time, these failed relationships are seen in retrospect as 'evidence of failure', gradually solidifying into negative expectations about one's relationship prospects.

core_beliefs: I am not worthy of being loved
I am destined to be Loneliness

special_situations.event: Recalling past romantic experiences and the breakup six months ago at night when Being alone
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am Single now, it means I am not loved and will not find a partner in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to use hobbies and socializing to distract attention, but avoids confiding deeply in relatives and friends lest she 'add burden'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will always be alone; no one will love me in the future

special_situations.event: A sudden, unexpected breakup six months ago
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If a relationship ends suddenly, it proves something is essentially wrong with me and I am not worthy of being loved
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly examines one's own failures, lowers expectations, and spends less time with friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Something is wrong with me; no one will truly love me

special_situations.event: Recalling several failed past relationships and using them as evidence
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: A few failures mean all future attempts will fail; past negative experiences determine the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses only on the failure parts to 'prove' their own judgment, avoiding positive evidence (such as others' care for them)
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My relationships always end in failure, so I cannot find love

special_situations.event: Thinking of confiding current troubles to friends or Mother
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I express negative emotions and worries, I will burden them or be disliked by them
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Choosing Silence, bearing it alone, not discussing inner feelings with family and friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should not trouble them; they will think I am a burden

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be loved and accepted; to build a stable, intimate relationship
core_conflict.fear: Fearing Being rejected or abandoned again, worrying about being judged after exposing vulnerability, being seen as 'having problems'
defense_goal: Staying safe by reducing self-disclosure and emotional expression, avoiding being hurt and Being rejected again

object_relations.self_representation: A flawed Loneliness person who may be Being rejected
object_relations.object_representation: Rejecters who may suddenly leave or judge oneself (such as an ex)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites them to share feelings with family and friends or suggests conducting behavioral experiments to challenge negative beliefs
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes expressing distress will make him a burden to others and he may be judged or rejected
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Cautious, reserved tone, using reasons like 'I do not want to trouble others' 'this may not help' to delay or avoid actions, fewer emotional details.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: At night when Being alone, recalling failed relationships and being asked about specific emotions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Focusing attention on evidence of failure, weakening positive relationship experiences in order to avoid the renewed disappointment brought by expectations
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Narrating experiences in a general, analytical way, reducing emotional word use, avoiding entering present feelings.

manifestations: The Single status seen as evidence of 'not being loved'
Intensified worry and despair at night when Being alone
Struggling to open up about feelings to supporters (friends, Mother)
outcomes: Persistent sense of Loneliness and despair

manifestations: Hopelessness about finding love in the future
Seeing past relationship failures as decisive evidence for the future
outcomes: Reduced motivation and sense of hope

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves.
manifestations: Not expressing troubles to friends or Mother, choosing to bear them alone
When needing support, instead suppresses one's own expression

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: Believing confiding to family and friends will make them see oneself as a burden, thus inferring they will not be willing to accept oneself

positive_force: Has supportive qualities (self-rated in past relationships as a supportive and caring partner)
Willing to try counseling and change, and can recognize the problems in one's thinking patterns
negative_force: Significant cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization, predicting the future, mental filtering
Rumination and Increasing worry at night when Being alone
Avoids opening up to others and seeking help; social contraction
Sleep disturbed, Low mood affecting Work and daily functioning

target_behavior.behavior: Intense worry and despair at night when Being alone (ruminative thoughts)
antecedent: Recalling the sudden breakup six months ago and past failed relationships
target_behavior.core_reason: Breakup trauma activates the 'I am not worthy of being loved' core belief, maintained by cognitive patterns such as catastrophizing, predicting the future and mental filtering
target_behavior.function: Escaping the emotional pain of uncertainty and potential rejection through preemptive despair
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep disturbed, Low mood and despair, daily functioning and Decline in work concentration

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding interacting with friends, struggling to reveal feelings to supporters (friends, Mother)
antecedent: When thinking of confiding in family and friends
When invited to socialize or talk about feelings
target_behavior.core_reason: Worries about becoming a burden to others or being judged (personalization/mind-reading tendency), to avoid being hurt again
target_behavior.function: Avoids possible embarrassment or rejection, maintaining surface safety and a sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal tension, intensified Loneliness, unable to gain external support and comfort
